_about: Rewrite of every pending 12:15 pm and 6:30 pm feed post and 4:30 pm Reel caption from 28 Oct to 8 Nov 2026 (owner, 27 Oct: 'it's all so repetitive'). Each day now has a different angle (tip, compare, idea, question, new product, proof) and a different call to action; the delivery line moved out of the caption; no product headlines twice in 14 days. Prices checked against the live store on 27 Oct 2026. Media kept where the product stayed; swapped to Shopify CDN photos where the product changed. 'draft': false means the post goes out (several were parked as drafts). Metricool ids change on every update; uuid stays.

What does P4/R11 on a tile page actually mean?
It's the slip rating. P is the wet pendulum test, P1 slippery to P5 grippiest. R is the ramp test, R9 to R13. As a rule of thumb: P3 for a bathroom floor, P4 or better for the shower floor and outdoors.
Time Stone Charcoal in matt is P4/R11, so the same dark tile can run from the living room into the shower. From $50.10/m².
